integrity: The all-t theorem is analytic. Exact algebraic verification checks the contact certificate, factorization, and uniqueness determinant; finite sampling is not used as a proof.
scientific_limitations: The result evaluates only the two-element support H={3,4}, not arbitrary finite supports.
The 1995 Revesz article was identifiable bibliographically but its full text was not accessible for a complete statement-by-statement comparison; this remains a literature risk.
title: Exact Carathéodory–Fejér constant for \(H=\{3,4\}\)
